query: Build the P2 landing page from the brief below at /business/wholesalers. It is a modification of /business with the middle rewritten, a hook swap over eight ad routes, and the same pricing block, trial form and footer. [paste a real P-series brief here when running this evaluation]
expected_behavior: Creates business/wholesalers/index.html using root-absolute /assets/ paths, not ../assets/
Copies the pricing block, lead form and footer verbatim from /business rather than retyping them
Puts page-specific CSS in its own stylesheet, not in assets/site-v4.css
Splits the hook-swap script: resolution in , application immediately after the
Does not put data-word-rise on the hook headline
Adds the vercel.json rewrite plus the trailing-slash and /index.html redirects, the sitemap entry, and the llms.txt and llms-full.txt entries
Runs check-routing.js, check-shared-schema.js and qa-page.js --hooks, and reports the results
Screenshots the page and confirms the hero CTA is above the fold for the longest hook
